meta.query_interpretation: Interpreted as a comparison question, grouped by phase, rendered as a grouped bar chart.
assumptions: I treated "phases" as the grouping axis within a comparison of the two drugs.
warnings: Fetched 500 of 2,922 matching trials for Pembrolizumab (capped at max_studies=1,000, split into a 500-trial share for this series); figures below describe that sample, not the full result set.
Fetched 500 of 2,016 matching trials for Nivolumab (capped at max_studies=1,000, split into a 500-trial share for this series); figures below describe that sample, not the full result set.
Trials can belong to more than one bucket on this axis (for example a combined Phase 1/2 trial), so bucket totals may sum to more than the number of trials.
72 of 944 trials had no value for this axis and are shown as a separate bucket.
